method: Round 6, a wider pkg.go.dev window: six package searches ('yaml parser', 'yaml decoder', 'yaml 1.2', 'yaml lexer', 'yaml ast', 'yaml unmarshal'; first 100 hits each, 'yaml lexer' and 'yaml ast' return 21 and 19), captured 2026-11-18 between 01:37 and 01:39 UTC. Metric: pkg.go.dev Imported by from the search snippet (round-1 source). Hits already in the round-1 snapshot or leads.json are not repeated. Every new hit with a positive value is decided: (1) fork overlap with the round-3 method (module zips from proxy.golang.org, @latest unless noted; distinct stripped non-comment lines of top-level non-test .go files) against gopkg.in/yaml.v2 v2.4.0 and gopkg.in/yaml.v3 v3.0.1, against github.com/ghodss/yaml v1.0.0 for ghodss-like modules, and against github.com/kylelemons/go-gypsy v1.0.0 yaml/ for go-gypsy forks; (2) the YAML/JSON imports of the remaining hits from their pkg.go.dev imports tab; (3) module zips read for the named candidates; (4) proxy.golang.org version lists for release pins. Two hits passed both controls and are promoted (go-rotini/yaml, golib parse/yaml; their projects carry the Docker and AFL++ receipts). The YAML reference parser was inspected with a local Go 1.27.1 event dump on the two valid controls (no Docker harness, no malformed input).
